title: ESL attenuates BLM-induced IPF in mice: Dual mediation of the TLR4/NF-kappaB and TGF-beta1/PI3K/Akt/FOXO3a pathways.
authors: Jia, Canchao; Yang, Minjuan; Xiao, Guanlin; Zeng, Zhihao; Li, Lingjie; Li, Yangxue; Jiang, Jieyi; Xu, Aili; Qiu, Jinyan; Tang, Ruiyin; Li, Dongmei; Jia, Dezheng; Xie, Canhui; Wu, Guangying; Cai, Dake; Bi, Xiaoli
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药ESL缓解肺纤维化的抗炎与抗EMT机制，仅涉及分子对接预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUNDS: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a persistent and advanced pulmonary ailment. The roles of innate immunity and adaptive immunity are pivotal in the evolution of IPF. An ill-adjusted interaction between epithelial cells and immune cells is responsible for initiating the epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) process and sustaining chronic inflammation, thereby fostering fibrosis progression. The intricacy of IPF pathogenesis has hindered the availability of efficacious agents. Elephantopus scaber Linn. (ESL) is a canonical Chinese medicine with significant immunoregulatory effects, and its aqueous extract has been proven to attenuate IPF symptoms in bleomycin (BLM)-induced mice. However, the underlying mechanism through which ESL relieves IPF remains unclear. AIM: To validate whether ESL reverses IPF by mediating the immune response and EMT. METHODS: Ultra-performance liquid chromatography with quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry (UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS) and UPLC were used to identify the components and determine the concentrations of the specific compounds in the ESL. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were applied to predict the potential mechanism underlying the anti-IPF effect of ESL. BLM-induced IPF mice were used to validate the anti-IPF effect of ESL, and lung tissue was collected to test putative pathways involved in inflammation and EMT via immunohistochemistry (ICH), real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) and Western blotting. RESULTS: Sixty-one compounds were identified, and thirteen main ingredients were quantified in the ESL. In silico experiments predicted that the IPF-mediated reversal of adverse effects by ESL would be related to interruption of the Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)/nuclear factor-k-gene binding (NF-kB) inflammatory pathway and the transforming growth factor-beta l (TGF-beta1)/phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K)/protein kinase B (Akt)/forkhead box O3 (FOXO3a) fibrosis pathway. In vivo experiments showed that ESL alleviates BLM-induced lung inflammation and fibrosis by reducing neutrophil aggregation and fibroblast foci, similar to the effects of the positive control drug pirfenidone (PFD). ESL markedly inhibited the transcription of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6, which are downstream genes of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Furthermore, the protein levels of TLR4 and p-NF-kappaB were correspondingly inhibited in response to ESL treatment. Additionally, ESL reverses BLM-induced changes in the expression of EMT-related biological characteristic indicators (collagen I [COLIA1], E-cadherin, and alpha smooth muscle actin [alpha-SMA]) at the messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA) level and markedly inhibits the expression of EMT-related upstream proteins (TGF-beta1, p-PI3K, p-Akt, and p-FOXO3a). CONCLUSION: Our research suggested that ESL attenuates BLM-induced IPF through mediating the EMT process via the TGF-beta1/PI3K/Akt/FOXO3a signaling pathway and inhibiting inflammation through the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, highlighting that ESL can serve as an immunoregulator for relieving the abnormal immune response and reversing the EMT in IPF.
abstract_zh: 背景：特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种持续进展的晚期肺部疾病。先天免疫和适应性免疫在IPF的演变中起着关键作用。上皮细胞与免疫细胞之间的失调相互作用负责启动上皮-间质转化（EMT）过程并维持慢性炎症，从而促进纤维化进展。IPF发病机制的复杂性阻碍了有效药物的开发。苦地胆（Elephantopus scopus Linn.，ESL）是一种具有显著免疫调节作用的典型中药，其水提物已被证明可减轻博来霉素（BLM）诱导小鼠的IPF症状。然而，ESL缓解IPF的潜在机制仍不清楚。目的：验证ESL是否通过介导免疫反应和EMT来逆转IPF。方法：采用超高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间质谱（UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS）和UPLC鉴定ESL中的成分并测定特定化合物的浓度。应用网络药理学和分子对接预测ESL抗IPF效应的潜在机制。使用BLM诱导的IPF小鼠验证ESL的抗IPF效应，并收集肺组织，通过免疫组织化学（IHC）、实时定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）和Western blotting检测涉及炎症和EMT的推定通路。结果：在ESL中鉴定出61种化合物，并定量了13种主要成分。计算机模拟实验预测，ESL逆转IPF相关不良效应可能与中断Toll样受体4（TLR4）/核因子-κB（NF-κB）炎症通路和转化生长因子-β1（TGF-β1）/磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶（PI3K）/蛋白激酶B（Akt）/叉头框蛋白O3（FOXO3a）纤维化通路有关。体内实验表明，ESL通过减少中性粒细胞聚集和成纤维细胞灶来减轻BLM诱导的肺部炎症和纤维化，与阳性对照药物吡非尼酮（PFD）的效果相似。ESL显著抑制了NF-κB信号通路下游基因TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-6的转录。此外，ESL处理相应抑制了TLR4和p-NF-κB的蛋白水平。另外，ESL在信使核糖核酸（mRNA）水平上逆转了BLM诱导的EMT相关生物学特征指标（胶原蛋白I [COLIA1]、E-钙黏蛋白和α-平滑肌肌动蛋白 [α-SMA]）表达变化，并显著抑制EMT相关上游蛋白（TGF-β1、p-PI3K、p-Akt和p-FOXO3a）的表达。结论：我们的研究表明，ESL通过TGF-β1/PI3K/Akt/FOXO3a信号通路介导EMT过程，并通过TLR4/NF-κB信号通路抑制炎症，从而减轻BLM诱导的IPF，凸显ESL可作为免疫调节剂，用于缓解异常免疫反应并逆转IPF中的EMT。
